scenes.title: Opening Theme Song
scenes.summary: Opening title sequence for Episode 12 of Behind the Scenes.

scenes.title: Your Path Is Becoming a True Producer
scenes.summary: On the way to the airport, Chun Yuqiao tells Bu Xiaogu her future lies in becoming a true producer rather than anyone's assistant; burying herself in overtime all week, Xiaogu declines Xingzi's offer to go out drinking.
scenes.location: airport car and chief editor's office

scenes.title: Even Kaiwen and Xingzi Clocked Off
scenes.summary: Lured out of the office by an urgent phone call from her admirer claiming a fan-club crisis, Bu Xiaogu discovers he staged a lighthearted heartbreak-and-feast gathering to cheer her up and accepts a ride home.

scenes.title: True Gold Always Shines
scenes.summary: Moved when young singer Bai Yang confesses that last year's controversy left every agency afraid to sign her, Xin Huimei phones her manager to reclaim her wild-card slot for Episode One and encourages Bai Yang.

scenes.title: Pulling Off This Episode on Our Own
scenes.summary: Right before taping, Xin Huimei's manager asks Kaiwen to add Bai Yang as a wild-card duet singing Luo Lin's signature hit; determined to prove Unit One can run without bothering Chun Yuqiao abroad, Kaiwen approves it.

scenes.title: How Is Your Stomach? Celebrate When You Return
scenes.summary: Host Wen Simo introduces Xin Huimei's mystery wild-card duet onstage to explosive viewer buzz; when Chun Yuqiao phones the office late at night, Bu Xiaogu answers alone, mentions one uneasy detail, and asks after his stomach.
scenes.location: Twelve Singers stage and Xingtian office

scenes.title: Next Comes Original Chinese Programming
scenes.summary: After concluding overseas partnership talks and visiting his alma mater, Chun Yuqiao returns to tell his foreign partners that Xingtian intends to create original Chinese shows for global audiences—just as a lawsuit hits.

scenes.title: Someone Planted a Trap for Us
scenes.summary: Served with a court summons over the duet song's copyright, Stella confronts Unit One; checking the original legal contract, Kaiwen discovers the song was omitted in a trap planted when Wang Er mentored Bu Xiaogu.

scenes.title: Wang Er and Luo Lin Toast Their Trap
scenes.summary: In a private room, Wang Er and Luo Lin gloat over timing the copyright trap for the exact moment Chun Yuqiao traveled abroad and Xingtian prepared to sign its overseas partnership.

scenes.title: Do You Know Why Wang Er Was Fired Last Year?
scenes.summary: Shocked to hear Kaiwen accuse her former mentor Wang Er of framing them, Bu Xiaogu learns from Kaiwen and Xingzi that Wang Er repeatedly leaked Xingtian's plans to rival ME and was fired on hard evidence.

scenes.title: Apologizing Amid Triple-Damages Claims
scenes.summary: As entertainment news reports triple-damages claims and stalled listing plans for Xingtian, PR director Stella issues a formal public apology and asks for time to locate the song's original composer.
scenes.location: news broadcast and Xingtian press lobby

scenes.title: Overseas Review and Boardroom Pressure
scenes.summary: The overseas partner announces its headquarters is reviewing the Xingtian deal over the copyright scandal, prompting Xingtian's board chairman to summon an emergency directors' meeting.

scenes.title: I Have a Right to Know
scenes.summary: Returning to Xin Huimei's apartment, Chun Yuqiao promises to resolve the lawsuit yet begs her never to get entangled with Luo Lin again; hurt by his refusal to explain his past, Huimei watches him leave for the office.

scenes.title: Luo Lin's Televised Accusations
scenes.summary: On a gossip program, Luo Lin claims Chun Yuqiao bought ten-year song rights by trading her management contract and treated singers and songs alike as pawns.

scenes.title: Pretending Resentment to Probe Wang Er
scenes.summary: While Xingzi pledges that she and Kaiwen will weather every storm beside Chun Yuqiao, Bu Xiaogu visits Wang Er undercover, feigning bitterness over Yuqiao's treatment to draw out the truth behind the trap.
scenes.location: Chun Yuqiao's office and Wang Er's tea room
